def mutate(x, info, rng):
    lo, hi, types = info["lower"], info["upper"], info["types"]
    n = len(x)
    y = list(x)
    cand = [i for i in range(n) if types[i] in ('real', 'integer')]
    idx = [rng.choice(cand)] if cand else []
    for i in idx:
        v = y[i] + rng.gauss(0.0, 1.0) * info['sigma'] * 2.0 * max(min(y[i] - lo[i], hi[i] - y[i]), 0.05 * (hi[i] - lo[i]))
        w = hi[i] - lo[i]
        if w > 0:
            r = (v - lo[i]) % (2.0 * w)
            v = lo[i] + (2.0 * w - r if r > w else r)
        if types[i] == 'integer':
            v = float(round(v))
        v = min(max(v, lo[i]), hi[i])
        y[i] = v
    pass
    pass
    return y
